title: The Sagittarius new moon
caption: tuesday night's new moon in sagittarius is a blank page in the sign of honesty. name the feeling you want, plant three things you won't bend on, and trust the dark for a few days. follow for the next portal ✦
sources: New Moon Dec 8, 2026, 4:51 pm PT (7:51 pm ET; 00:51 UTC Dec 9) at 16°56' Sagittarius — https://chani.com/this-year/key-dates/2026-astrological-key-dates-new-and-full-moons
New moon = Moon between Earth and Sun, its lit side facing away; Sagittarius = the archer, ruled by Jupiter, associated with honesty and travel.
Date note: Dec 9 in UTC and east of the Americas; the spoken line says Tuesday night (Americas).
